errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS.next: Check your details and try again.
errors.CSRF_FAILED.next: Reload the page and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN.next: Ask the workspace owner for help.
errors.NOT_FOUND.what: We could not find what you were looking for.
errors.NOT_FOUND.next: Check the address or go back to the home page.
errors.CONFLICT_STATE.what: This action is not possible in the current state.
errors.CONFLICT_STATE.next: Reload the page and try again.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT.what: Someone changed this while you were working.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT.next: Reload the page and try again.
errors.FACT_VERSION_CONFLICT.what: This information was changed by someone else while you were editing.
errors.FACT_VERSION_CONFLICT.next: Reload to see the latest value, then edit again.
errors.JOB_PAYLOAD_INVALID.what: Internal error: a background job had an invalid payload.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR.next: Try again. If it keeps happening, share the request ID ({request_id}).
errors.APPROVAL_ALREADY_DECIDED.what: A decision was already made on this approval.
errors.APPROVAL_ALREADY_DECIDED.next: Reload the page to see the current state.
errors.APPROVAL_STALE.what: What you were about to approve has changed.
errors.APPROVAL_STALE.next: Review the current summary and decide again.
errors.MESSAGING_WINDOW_CLOSED.what: Instagram only allows a reply within 24 hours of the customer's last message, and that time is over.
errors.MESSAGING_WINDOW_CLOSED.next: Wait for the customer to write again, or contact them another way.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_CONNECTED.what: The Instagram account is not connected right now.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_CONNECTED.next: Connect the account again under Settings, then try once more.
errors.MEDIA_INVALID.what: This file is not a supported image.
errors.MEDIA_INVALID.next: Upload a JPEG or PNG image.
errors.MEDIA_TOO_LARGE.what: This image file is too large.
errors.MEDIA_TOO_LARGE.next: Choose a smaller image (the default limit is 8 MB).
errors.FACT_NOT_USABLE.what: This information is not verified yet, so it cannot be used.
errors.FACT_NOT_USABLE.next: Verify it first under Business information.
errors.FACT_CHANGED_MEANWHILE.what: The information was changed by someone else while you were confirming, so it was not updated.
errors.FACT_CHANGED_MEANWHILE.next: Check the current value and give the command again.
errors.LLM_UNAVAILABLE.what: The AI service is not reachable right now.
errors.LLM_UNAVAILABLE.next: Try again in a moment, or enter the information manually.
errors.LLM_OUTPUT_INVALID.what: I could not understand that command.
errors.LLM_OUTPUT_INVALID.next: Try a simpler sentence, or enter the information manually.
errors.LLM_REFUSED.what: The AI did not answer this request.
errors.LLM_REFUSED.next: Rephrase it, or do it manually.
errors.LLM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.what: Today's AI usage limit has been reached.
errors.LLM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.next: Try again tomorrow, or do it manually.
errors.CONTENT_VALIDATION_FAILED.what: This content cannot be submitted yet.
errors.CONTENT_VALIDATION_FAILED.next: Fix the listed items, then submit again.
content.issue.MEDIA_NOT_READY: The image is not ready. Upload it again.
content.issue.CAPTION_REQUIRED: A feed post needs a caption.
content.issue.CAPTION_TOO_LONG: The caption has {length} characters; the limit is {max}.
content.issue.CAPTION_NOT_ALLOWED: A story is published without a caption. Remove the caption.
content.issue.ASPECT_RATIO_OUT_OF_RANGE: The image is {width}x{height}. A feed image must be between 4:5 and 1.91:1.
content.issue.CLAIM_VALIDATION_FAILED: The text contains prices, dates or similar details that are not taken from verified business information.
content.issue.SCHEDULE_IN_PAST: The chosen time has already passed.
content.issue.SCHEDULE_TOO_FAR: A post can be scheduled at most 60 days ahead.
content.issue.SCHEDULE_TIME_NONEXISTENT: {local_time} does not exist on {local_date} in {timezone} (the clocks skip that hour). Choose another time.
content.issue.SCHEDULE_TOO_SOON_FOR_APPR: Someone has to approve this before it is published. Choose a time at least {minutes} minutes from now.
content.issue.ACCOUNT_NOT_CONNECTED: No Instagram account is connected right now.
content.issue.CAPABILITY_MISSING: The connected account is not allowed to publish this type of post.
content.issue.PUBLISH_QUOTA_FORECAST_EXC: Too many posts are already scheduled around this time. Choose another time.
content.issue.STORY_ASPECT_NOT_9_16: Stories look best at 9:16. This image may be cropped.
content.issue.OVERLAY_TOO_LONG: This overlay text is long for a story. Keep it to 3 short lines.
errors.MEDIA_REJECTED.what: Instagram could not process the image.
errors.MEDIA_REJECTED.next: Replace it with another image and schedule the post again.
errors.PUBLISH_DEADLINE_PASSED.what: The post could not be published in time.
errors.PUBLISH_DEADLINE_PASSED.next: Choose a new time and schedule it again.
errors.PUBLISH_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.what: The daily publishing limit has been reached.
errors.PUBLISH_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.next: It will be tried again automatically later.
errors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.what: Instagram is not reachable right now.
errors.PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED.what: Instagram asked us to slow down.
errors.PROVIDER_REJECTED.next: Review the post and schedule it again.
errors.CAPABILITY_MISSING.what: Permission for this action was not granted.
errors.CAPABILITY_MISSING.next: Reconnect the account and allow it.
errors.ACCOUNT_NEEDS_REAUTH.what: The Instagram connection must be renewed.
errors.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.what: We are still checking whether it was published.
errors.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.next: Wait a moment. Do not post it again by hand yet.
errors.OUTCOME_UNCONFIRMED.what: We could not confirm whether it was published.
errors.OUTCOME_UNCONFIRMED.next: Check Instagram before posting it again.
errors.REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND.what: I could not find the post you mentioned.
errors.REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND.next: Name it by its date or title, or pick it in Content.
content.hold.FACT_CHANGED.what: It was put on hold because business information it uses has changed.
content.hold.FACT_CHANGED.next: Review the text, then approve it again.
content.hold.ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE.what: It was put on hold because the Instagram account was not available.
content.hold.ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE.next: Reconnect the account in Settings, then approve it again.
content.failure.unknown.next: Open the post to see the details, then edit or schedule it again.
